title: Measures vanishing off U and finite on compacts of U are determined by their values on open subsets of U
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, and μ, μ' Borel measures on ℝ^N with μ(ℝ^N ∖ U) = 0, μ'(ℝ^N ∖ U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and μ(O) = μ'(O) for every open O ⊆ U. Then μ = μ'.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ μ' : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → μ' Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → μ O = μ' O) → μ = μ'
